subject.title: fix(anthropic): restrict OAuth callback host to loopback addresses and derive redirect URI

question: Should OpenClaw accept loopback-only Anthropic OAuth callback hosts and derived redirect URIs as the supported hardening path for this shipped helper?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it changes a previously accepted env value surface in provider auth and the security severity depends on maintainer interpretation of trusted environment control.

options.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
options.body: Approve the fail-closed loopback allowlist because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape and the patch follows the sibling OAuth pattern.

options.title: Require Live Provider Exchange Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted live Anthropic token-exchange proof for the allowed loopback spellings before accepting provider-side redirect registration risk.

options.title: Pause For Auth Direction
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers prefer removing or deprecating the direct Anthropic OAuth helper instead of hardening it.

recommendation.title: Accept Loopback-Only Anthropic OAuth
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed loopback allowlist because arbitrary remote callback hosts are not a supported local CLI auth shape and the patch follows the sibling OAuth pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned on the live PR and has the strongest adjacent auth/runtime ownership signal for the maintainer tradeoff.
